Freelancer.com · Associate Product Manager · 2023–2025

Client notification experiment

Used user interviews and A/B testing to change how clients are notified, which increased hired freelancers by 9%.

  • +9% hired freelancers
  • Marketplace
  • A/B testing
  • User research

The problem

In a two-sided marketplace, a freelancer only gets paid once a client hires them. Clients who posted a project weren’t always acting on it, so good freelancers lost work.

What I did

  • Revived the user interview process to understand freelancer and client workflows, and found friction points worth testing.
  • Designed and ran an iterative A/B test on client notifications.
  • Partnered with international engineering and design teams to ship each iteration.

The outcome

  • +9% increase in hired freelancers
